Subject: A way to keep print requests and proof comments together

Hi Rina,

I’m Tess Morgan at Cedar Desk. I understand Harbor Print had 14 open jobs last month and that 3 needed a revised proof. That mix of active work and proof revisions made me think a closer look at how requests and comments are kept together might be useful.

Cedar Desk collects print-job requests in a form and keeps proofing comments attached to each job. That gives a team a place to refer back to the request and the comments associated with the work. I would be interested to hear how your team handles those details today and whether this approach fits the way Harbor Print works.

Would you be open to a 15-minute demonstration? I can walk you through the request form and where proofing comments sit, and leave room for your questions. If the approach is not relevant to your workflow, that is useful to know too. Either way, I would appreciate hearing what matters most to your team when a proof needs another look.

Best,
Tess Morgan
Cedar Desk
